description: Source code for a Kubernetes admission plugin that enforces the existence of namespaces during admission requests.

classes.name: Exists
classes.description: Admission plugin that checks if a namespace exists before allowing certain operations.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation to ensure the namespace exists, checking caches and directly querying the API server if needed.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Exists admission plugin.

methods.description: Sets the Kubernetes client for the plugin.

methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized with necessary components.
